title: Agents With Keys: CI Authority Measurement and Bounded Proposal Validation
description: Research software for read-only workflow configuration measurement, documented public-repository snapshots, aggregate reporting, closed-schema proposal validation, and recorded-trial evidence checks. Version 0.1.0 is a research prototype, not a complete credential broker, live-agent defense, or independently evaluated security product. Only aggregate study evidence is released; source snapshots and identity mappings are controlled separately.
